title: AppBotSleepAsync: CDP condition-based wait (no blind delay)
desc: CDP-aware polling helper replacing all Task.Delay blind waits. Exit condition is mandatory -- blind sleep is forbidden in CDP code. Default poll 33ms (~30fps).
steps: USE: await CdpClient.AppBotSleepAsync(maxMs, async () => { var r = await EvalAsync(...); return r == expected; })
Default poll interval: 33ms (~30fps). CDP round-trip is 1-50ms so 33ms catches condition within 1-2 cycles.
NEVER use Task.Delay >= 1000ms in CDP code without an exit condition. All blind waits are bugs -- file suggest if found.
